run_plot_from_logs: run the script to generate a PNG plot from a pickle log data file
run_plot_with_xkey: run the script with a custom x-axis key to plot cumulative sample counts
run_plot_with_xscale: run the script with an x-axis scaling factor to adjust plot spacing
review_plot_from_logs: review the script that loads pickle experiment logs and generates multi-subplot PNG visualizations
refactor_plot_from_logs: refactor the script to support additional output formats beyond PNG for experiment plots
